EA.note: Flat within roughly a percentage point and essentially independent of drift magnitude: the measured-tension feedforward compensates the stiffness change in real time.

f.note: The paper prints the noise-free pair only.

J.note: J enters neither the model-based equilibrium torque nor the cascade feedforward, which leaves it the only parameter uncompensated by cascade control.

per_roller_reference.note: The per-roller diagnostic reads a CHANGE from the plant's own pre-drift profile, not an absolute ranking. The pre-drift profile is not flat and depends on the acquisition condition.

pre_drift_worst_roller.note: Under the drift campaign's tension-only acquisition the nip already carries the largest stiffness error with no drift; the unwinder does so only at the representative dual-channel condition.

extreme_J_noise_free.RW_note: Rewinder sits between UW and Nip; the paper does not print its value.

extreme_J_sensor_noise.note: The localization blurs under sensor noise, so it is best read from noise-free logs.

nip_change_under_extreme_J.note: The nip stays put while UW and RW more than double.
